nodes.long_description:
# Become part of an elite special forces unit in Tactical Assault VR!

• Habie147 - ‘Tactical Assault Is One Of The Best Hardcore Shooters I’ve Played’

• Gamertag VR - ‘The Best Tactical VR FPS On Quest’

• Controlled Pairs - ‘The Best CQB Game I've Ever Played’

Tactical Assault VR is an intense tactical shooter where you use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to stack up, breach doors and eliminate threats. Play solo or join an online co-op special forces unit in missions around the world.

# Features
**PvE Missions: Solo or Online Multiplayer Co-Op with Up to 6 Players**
{1487526115258066}

**PvP: Competitive Online Multiplayer**
{1082589306850803}

**9 Non-Linear Asymmetrical Missions, 3 Wave Shooter Experiences, Room Randomizer & Sandbox Mode**

Plan your assault. The choice is yours.
{448475627682065}

**Game Mode Variety**

Bomb Defusal, Hostage Rescue, Enemy Surrendering, High-Value Target (HVT) Eliminations, Mini Games, Killhouse, Hardcore Mode.
{1946208202559962}

**60+ Detailed Weapons and Counting**

Customize your loadout with tactical gear including vests, helmets, weapons, scopes, sights, grips and breaching equipment.
{1007758587705278}

nodes.long_description:
Become part of an elite special forces unit and use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to clear rooms, breach doors, and defeat the enemy threat.

FEATURES:

• Utilize an arsenal of weapons, scopes, sight attachments, explosives and equipment.

• Take note of simulated wind and target distance with the wind meter and spotter scope. Calculate physics-based bullet drop and time-to-hit to improve your accuracy.

• Use stealth to sneak up behind enemies with a silent knife kill. Or go head-to-head against enemies that will take cover and attempt to flank your position.

• Randomized Enemy positions and doors, making each play-through an unknown challenge.

• Non-linear maps give players an endless variety in how they choose to infiltrate and complete missions. Enter buildings through doors, climb ladders to reach rooftops, or climb through windows. The choice is yours.

Tactical Assault VR is currently an Early Access release and is updated regularly.

Tactical Assault VR v0.9.251 Bug Fixes
• Scene Loading refinements
• Fixed network error sending players back to main menu with a cloned avatar
• Fixed network error joining pvp mid-load
• Fixed player movement not disabling when kia
• Fixed voice being heard by players when kia
• Various Sights position adjustments closing gaps
• Deadshot planning map rotated to have NORTH face upwards
• Fixed Voice gender not setting correctly
• Fixed Melee attacks on civilians not registering violation
• Fixed enemy not performing melee
• Various network refinements
• (Quest) Removed Space Warp
• Fixed mission complete loading back to lobby bug
• Fixed 0% loading bug if host leaves Sandstorm lobby and closes the room
• Fixed Team Radio bug in PvP

Puddle Updates:
• Added auto eject of grenades with barrel open and pointing up over 60 degrees
• Updated PM pistol model (increased rear sight width for better visibility)
• Changed m203 unlock button from trigger to primary button to match the other grenade launchers
• Updated m16a2 quadrant step size from 50m to 10m
• (PCVR) Fixed custom audio folder names for recently added guns and grenade launchers

Tactical Assault VR v0.9.25
• Added Collapsing Star PvP
• Added Shattered Eagle PvP
• Added Retaliatory Bite PvP (Convention Center)
• Added Avatar Customization Profiles (3 profile slots. Select the profile, customize, press SAVE to save that profile)
• Added MICH High Scrim Helmets (4 camo styles available) (by Canto)

• Fixed: Enemies yelling "target sighted" when they in fact do not have a target sighted
• Fixed: Bomber Rush Yelling before seeing target
• Fixed: possibility of enemy crouching and getting stuck
• Fixed: fake civilians getting stuck aiming but not firing after taking out pistol
• Fixed 40mm grenade visibility over multiplayer. Grabbing a 40mm will now be seen by other players
• Fixed Breaking Whisper exfil technical getting stuck on obstacle
• Fixed hostages zooming through doorways
• Fixed 1 hostage counting twice as rescue complete
• Fixed G36 family fire mode switches not resetting on respawn
• Fixed multiplayer attachments changing during weapon handoff 
• Fixed audio reload sound firing off at start of mission
• Fixed K2c sights position
• Fixed weapon loadout menu disappearing if team selection is full
• Fixed Female FM54 gas masks missing
• Fixed SMG AimDot sights positions

• Optimizations to player avatars
• Refinements to Scene Loading
• Changed: Bomber rushes towards the closest target rather than the aim target which can be NULL if the bomber doesn't see the player
• Updated Convention Center ai navigation

• Added M16a2 GL
